name: olivers-table-3p
note: OLIVER'S TABLE WITHOUT PURPHOROS, by the pilot's word 2026-10-25 ('take purphoros out please'). purphoros-pingers was only Tom's stand-in (his commander is unknown) and in the first v2.0.0 run (40 games, 2026-10-25, run c0f7e15a) it won 25 of 40 and dealt 70.5 noncombat damage a game, eliminating sharknado 18 times — a stand-in owning the table. Three players: sharknado plus Oliver's Araumi and Ryan's Teval, both EDHREC average lists (see olivers-table's note). olivers-table itself is kept unchanged: v2.0.0's merge reading and answers-v1's objective name it. Re-add a fourth seat when Tom names his deck (`fetch-opponent`). NEVER PLAYED in simulation until its first run.

seats.note: Oliver, 2026-10-20. Typed from the pilot's read of the table (a bracket-4 table), not from DeckCheck; `pods olivers-table --power` prints the average list's floor beside it.
seats.engine_why: Oliver's plan by his archetype and log 002 ('had me sacrificing creatures left and right'): edict bodies and the cards that put a creature in the graveyard or return one. Araumi's own encore is a floor. Read off the list before any audit named them.

seats.note: Ryan. Bracket 4 on DeckCheck per the pilot (2026-10-20); won game 002 on an infinite. The EDHREC average stands in for his modified precon.
seats.engine_why: data/opponents/teval-graveyard/NOTES.md: Teval pays when cards leave the graveyard, Gravecrawler is his loop's body; the rest fill or empty that graveyard. The average list runs no Phyrexian Altar. Read off the list before any audit named them.
